form: risk score = 1 / (1 + exp(-(b0 + b1*peak_overlap + b2*warm_observed_fraction + b3*longest_run_days)))

definitions.peak_overlap: share of the station's climatological hottest-30 window that the outage hides, from training years only, 0-1
definitions.warm_observed_fraction: share of May-September days that remain observed, 0-1
definitions.longest_run_days: length in days of the longest consecutive outage

use: rank station-years by the score and retain the lowest; or pick a cut-off from the retention your archive can afford
fitted_on: 110 development networks; scored unchanged on 36 reserved networks
